policy.allowed: append-only provenance registration stating WHEN, WHY and the NEW HASH
policy.forbidden: rewriting the record to claim the document was never edited
policy.why_the_prohibition_matters: the edit history is part of a frozen text's evidentiary value. Rewriting the record to say 'never edited' would lead every downstream reader to a false conclusion -- worse than the edit itself. Allowing the edit while requiring honest registration concedes that 'frozen' is a process discipline rather than absolute immutability; forbidding the rewrite preserves the usability of the record.
